name: Write Canary File to C:\Canary.txt
script:
# Define the file path
$filePath = "C:\Canary.txt"

# Write some content into the file
$env:message | Out-File -FilePath $filePath -Encoding UTF8
script_lines: # Write some content into the file

variables.name: message
variables.label: Canary Contents
variables.description: This is the message written inside of the canary file.
